results.expected_direction_unverified: Not measured — stated here only as an unverified expert expectation, not a result: small_distant's 0/4 is more likely explained by BlazeFace short_range's fixed low-resolution input (faces occupying <10% of frame carry little signal regardless of the confidence cutoff applied afterward) than by the confidence threshold itself, so a meaningful recall improvement there specifically would be surprising. multiple_faces (20% recall on 10 GT faces) is more plausibly threshold-sensitive, since NMS/confidence filtering in a crowded frame can suppress genuine borderline-confidence detections. This expectation is explicitly NOT a substitute for running the real test above.
